svg.aria-label: Data map: what is stored where, who sees it, how long it is kept, and whether AI reads it
svg.title: Data map: what is stored where, who sees it, how long it is kept, and whether AI reads it
svg.text: A note, when drafting its quote
Staff; landlord or agent it’s for
At least until the next test
Every account is in Wrenfield’s name, with two-step sign-in. AI calls go through Anthropic’s API, which doesn’t train on business data and deletes it within 30 days. Most suppliers store
data outside the UK, so each one’s data processing agreement and UK transfer terms are filed in the data pack.
